title: Arithmetic and Geometric Sequences and Series
seo_title: Grade 12 Sequences and Series Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Number patterns, including arithmetic and geometric sequences; derivation and application of the formulae for the sum of arithmetic and geometric series: Sₙ = n/2[2a + (n − 1)d], Sₙ = a(rⁿ − 1)/(r − 1), r ≠ 1.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 12 worksheets: arithmetic and geometric sequences and series, sums of n terms and word problems. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Arithmetic: Tₙ = a + (n − 1)d and Sₙ = n2[2a + (n − 1)d].
  • Geometric: Tₙ = arⁿ⁻¹ and Sₙ = a(rⁿ − 1)r − 1 (r ≠ 1).
  • Check the type first: a common difference or a common ratio?
  • To find n, set up the formula and solve; n must be a natural number.

Examples

Example

3 + 7 + 11 + … (20 terms)

a = 3, d = 4

S₂₀ = 10[6 + 19 × 4]

Answer: 820

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
n or n − 1Tₙ uses n − 1.
The wrong formulaDifference: arithmetic; ratio: geometric.
Tₙ or SₙThe sum adds all the terms.

items.q: Write the repeating decimal 0,222… as a fraction, using an infinite geometric series.
